quarterly_data.quarter: Resonac (Showa Denko) results briefing Q&A: 2nd Quarter 2026 Financial Results (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Hideki Somemiya (results briefing Q&A), after the upward revision of the FY2026 forecast: compared with 2026 1H, all subsegments of the Semiconductor and Electronic Materials segment are expected to achieve revenue growth in 2026 2H; by revenue growth rate the order is expected to be Back-end Process Materials, then Device Solutions, then Front-end Process Materials.

quarterly_data.quarter: Resonac (Showa Denko) results briefing Q&A: 2nd Quarter 2026 Financial Results (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO (results briefing Q&A): in the FY2026 forecast announced with the FY2025 results, AI-related products were expected to account for approximately 30% of revenue in the Back-end Materials subsegment; following the upward revision of the forecast, this proportion is now expected to exceed 30% of the subsegment's revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: AI-related products: approximately 30% of Back-end Materials revenue in the original FY2026 forecast, now expected to exceed 30%

quarterly_data.quarter: Resonac (Showa Denko) results briefing Q&A: 2nd Quarter 2026 Financial Results (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO (results briefing Q&A) on copper-clad laminates (CCL): as stated in the company's press release, Resonac negotiated price increases with customers; the impact has been partially reflected since 2026 Q2, and as further revenue contribution from the price increase is expected in 2026 2H and beyond, the FY2026 forecast incorporates this effect.

quarterly_data.quarter: Resonac (Showa Denko) results briefing Q&A: 2nd Quarter 2026 Financial Results (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO (results briefing Q&A) on hard disk (HD) media: demand is currently very strong; having recently reached price-revision agreements with customers, Resonac expects the revenue contribution from the price increase to be reflected from 2026 2H.

quarterly_data.quarter: Resonac (Showa Denko) results briefing Q&A: 2nd Quarter 2026 Financial Results (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO (results briefing Q&A) on technology risks such as NCF being replaced by hybrid bonding: the company assesses various scenarios associated with emerging technologies internally, and believes that the mass production of HBM utilizing hybrid bonding is still some way off; taking these risks into account it continues to develop semiconductor materials so it can respond to a wide range of technological developments.

quarterly_data.quarter: Resonac (Showa Denko) results briefing Q&A: 2nd Quarter 2026 Financial Results (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO (results briefing Q&A) on the Chemicals segment: the Graphite subsegment posted a loss in 2026 Q1 due to weak sales volumes, but its performance improved in 2026 Q2 to a near break-even outcome. The Chemicals segment is expected to achieve higher profit in 2026 2H than in 2026 1H, primarily because of the seasonality of Basic Chemicals (many chemical products undergo scheduled maintenance in 1H, while demand for products such as carbon dioxide is stronger in 2H).
quarterly_data.figure: Graphite: loss in 2026 Q1, near break-even in 2026 Q2
